label: Burxt
install: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates gcc libc6-dev && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

mkdir -p /tmp/b /usr/local/lib/burxt && tar xzf /tmp/b.tgz -C /tmp/b --strip-components=1 && install -m 755 /tmp/b/burxt /usr/local/bin/burxt && install -m 644 /tmp/b/lib/*.bx /usr/local/lib/burxt/ && rm -rf /tmp/b /tmp/b.tgz
